about.heading: About SkyTrail Travels
about.story: SkyTrail Travels is a growing Sri Lankan travel and tourism agency offering local and international holiday packages, adventure tours, corporate travel arrangements, honeymoon packages, hotel reservations and customised travel experiences. We've helped thousands of travellers explore Sri Lanka's hill country, beaches and wildlife, along with international escapes across Asia and the Indian Ocean.
about.mission: To make unforgettable travel experiences accessible, transparent and stress-free, from the first enquiry to the final day of your trip.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why we collect it and how we look after it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.text: When you create an account we store your name, email address and a hashed copy of your password (we never store the password itself). When you send a booking enquiry we store the traveller name, email, phone number, travel date, number of travellers and any special requests. Messages sent through the contact form are stored with the name and email you give us.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.text: We use this information only to run your account, answer your enquiries and arrange the trips you ask for. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site sets one session cookie when you log in so that we know who you are between pages. It is marked HttpOnly and SameSite so scripts and other sites cannot read it, and it expires after four hours. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.

third.title: Third parties
third.text: The fonts are served from this site. The map on the About page is loaded from OpenStreetMap, so your browser contacts that service directly and it can see your IP address. Exchange rates are fetched by our server, not by your browser. Nothing else is shared with other companies.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.text: We keep account and booking records for as long as your account exists. You can ask us to delete your account and personal data at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022, you can ask to see the data we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it deleted. Email enquiries@skytrailtravels.lk and we will reply within a reasonable time.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: If we change how we use your data we will update this page.

currency.note: Prices in other currencies are converted from LKR with daily exchange rates (last updated {{date}}) and are only a guide. Bookings are confirmed and charged in LKR.
